description: The plan skips the environment's what-if for a change as well (here for a new environment), so the approvers approve a deploy they haven't seen.

patches.find:
if [ "$env_changed" = true ]; then
  plat_arm what-if environment
patches.replace:
if [ "$env_changed" = true ] && [ "$pass" = 2 ]; then
  plat_arm what-if environment
